cells.gaps: The one source inside the as-at, of September 2021, reports the property-tax software handed over that day in one commune, Toamasina, with staff trained to replicate it; nothing says the commune went on to bill from it or that any other commune was equipped. Nothing is dated between then and the as-at, so governance and the last twelve months hold nothing; the partner ownership of 2021 falls outside the 36 months. Rows MDG-001 to MDG-003 are dated 7 October 2026, after the as-at, and set nothing.
cells.note: Software handed over in one commune, on the day of the handover, is read as a pilot. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in communes outside the capital, and no fact shows routine use after the handover.
